actuality.line: Visualizin' the realism of life in actuality
actuality.lineNext: Fuck who's the baddest, a person's status depends on salary

reality.line: Portraying Himmler's sacred realm of dream reality
stanza: I'm closer to the Golden Dawn
Immersed in Crowley's uniform of imagery
I'm living in a silent film
Portraying Himmler's sacred realm of dream reality

reality.line: See if I can hot-wire reality
stanza: I'm just rolling away from yesterday
Behind the wheel of a stolen Chevrolet
See if I can hot-wire reality

reality.line: Ah, but fortunately I have the key to escape reality
stanza: When I woke up this morning, things were looking bad
Seemed like total silence was the only friend I had
A bowl of oatmeal tried to stare me down and won
And it was twelve o'clock before I realized that I was having no fun
Ah, but fortunately I have the key to escape reality

reality.songTitle: I’ve Got You Under My Skin
reality.line: Use your mentality, wake up to reality
stanza: Don't you know, silly fool, you never can win
Use your mentality, wake up to reality
But each time I do, just the thought of you
Makes me stop before I begin
Cause I've got you under my skin
